Dependency audit: install the worker production dependencies from uv.lock or an equivalently enforced locked export; unlocked pip install of the source alone does not prove CI parity. Construct the database connection URL with correctly escaped credentials and prove reserved-character credentials reach the intended database. User decision2026-09-22: Redis is deferred. The current Compose topology must omit the Redis service and any Redis startup dependency. Any later introduction requires a demonstrated consumer and a separate approved planning change. Keep process-pool auto-creation through the existing --type process behavior; no separate pool service is required.

Dependency audit: distinguish published requirement compatibility from installed runtime compatibility. Record Python, Prefect, FastAPI, Pydantic, Pydantic-core and Starlette identities for both the locked environment and candidate image; exercise the existing API/worker smoke. Observed source lock is Prefect3.4.24, FastAPI0.115.14, Pydantic2.13.5, Pydantic-core2.46.5 and Starlette0.46.2 on Python3.12; their inspected published constraints intersect, but this is not proof of a working container.

Dependency audit: record immutable manifest/platform digests for PostgreSQL, the Prefect server and worker base, and the built worker candidate. Compare installed production packages against the reviewed lock, then verify the server and worker compatibility receipt. Image-tag existence alone is not byte identity, vulnerability clearance or runtime acceptance. Preserve the existing no-publication boundary.
